prompt_inputs.goal: Strength training and muscle recovery for weightlifting

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers one full day with at least 4 meals/snacks
Protein distributed across meals (minimum 25g per meal) totaling 130-150g daily
All foods comply with vegetarian restrictions
Compact format with clear meal times and portions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-focused athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein distribution across meals and recovery nutrition, with dietary restrictions (vegetarian or vegan)

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with carbohydrate loading for an upcoming race, requiring 3,500+ calories daily with optimized pre/during/post-workout nutrition timing

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full day with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks
Total daily calories meet high endurance athlete requirements (3,500+)
Includes specific pre-workout, during-workout, and post-workout nutrition with timing
All meals respect vegetarian and nut-free restrictions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a professional endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate loading, with specific timing for pre/during/post-workout nutrition

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize performance and recovery for soccer training and match play

solution_criteria: Includes 4-5 meals/snacks strategically timed around training sessions with pre- and post-exercise nutrition
Provides balanced macronutrients (carbohydrates for energy, protein for recovery, healthy fats) appropriate for a 75kg athlete
Contains practical, accessible food options that don't require extensive preparation
Includes hydration guidelines with specific fluid recommendations
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (soccer player) needing balanced macronutrients with practical meal timing around training sessions, including hydration guidelines and accessible food options
